scope: Implementation corrections within one v1.2 task; no label revisions or hidden failed-candidate removal.

repairs.issue: Dominant interval mode accidentally joined a true same-type tempo transition
repairs.correction: Require a uniform-row certificate before extending cadence display plateaus; preserve 150 to 200 and DT 225 to 300.

repairs.issue: Sparse chord accents inside a same-hand roll suggested a half-speed Jack clock
repairs.correction: Intervening notes outside the common fingers of adjacent coactive grips invalidate that backbone pair.

repairs.issue: Rejecting every intervening same-hand event removed valid Anchor plus Chordjack roles
repairs.correction: Allow common-finger retriggers as an additional role; keep them separate from unrelated roll motion.

repairs.issue: Median rounded source intervals biased 133 to 134 or DT 200 to 199
repairs.correction: Use the weighted mean of the supported narrow interval cluster, not its modal integer millisecond.

repairs.issue: Recomputing indices at unmoved endpoints changed the original observation contract
repairs.correction: Retain original indices at every unmoved endpoint; patch all affected grid outputs before full reselection.

repairs.issue: A fractional ideal barline placed a truncated source downbeat in the previous half-open interval
repairs.correction: Use the lower source-millisecond cell edge as the cut and retain nominalTime; replay changed inputs for every radius before full reselection.

repairs.issue: An early rate-fixture assertion recomputed an endpoint which runtime must preserve
repairs.correction: Assert the provided original endpoint index; separately test shifted internal indices and all three native rate clocks.

repairs.issue: Unresolved primary clock accidentally hid a supported secondary branch clock
repairs.correction: Measure secondary cadence independently before handling an unresolved primary. Primary BPM, labels, integrals and stored ablation metrics are unchanged.
